messages:
Priya G: Quick thread: follow-ups from last postmortem we need closed before the multi-region failover drill on 2026-05-02. Areas: routing affinity fallback, backup verification cadence, and restore orchestration timebox. Owners?
Nina R: I can take backup verification cadence. I'll define sampling frequency and a smoke verification job. Acceptance: sampling job runs weekly and flags anomalies to pagerduty. Due: 2026-04-26 EOD.
Omar Z: I'll own routing affinity fallback. Plan: implement a conservative fallback window + test with simulated control-plane lag. Acceptance: change in canary, test logs show fallback triggered and traffic stabilizes within SLA. Due: 2026-04-28.
Liam F: Restore orchestration timebox: will add a hard timeout and a fast-fail path for stuck restores. Acceptance: PR + integration test that simulates stuck state. Due: 2026-04-29.
Priya G: please add items to tracker and include acceptance artifacts (PRs, logs, scripts). Tracker URL: https://docs.internal/redwood/dr/rehearsal-2026/tracker
InfraBot: Temporary role created: dr-drill-temp-role-2026 expires 2026-05-04T00:00:00Z. IAM: https://internal.redwood/iam/roles/dr-drill-temp-role-2026
Nina R: note: recurring symptom = delayed kvcache priming after weight-sync timeouts. Adding a 1-line lead indicator: weight-sync latency > 15s.
Omar Z: test snippet for control-plane lag (staging):
```
ssh staging-control 'tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 250ms'
# run canary failover
ssh staging-control 'tc qdisc del dev eth0 root'
```
Use with approval.
Liam F: small ops ask: need short-lived DB read creds for validation. Infra team, can we get one?
InfraBot: Created db-read-temp-177111 with secret in 1Password path: incidents/dr-drill.
Priya G: blockers? If none, please confirm and update tracker by COB tomorrow. We'll run a prep rehearsal on 2026-04-30 16:00 UTC.
Nina R: no blockers. will update tracker.
Omar Z: ack, will schedule tests and paste logs.
Liam F: ack, will open PR for runbook change.
Priya G: thanks all. After you complete, add a 1-paragraph validation note and artifact links so we can fold into the postmortem follow-up bundle.
